title: Rename workbench minimal safety polish
summary: Tightens the existing Rename tab safety copy, stale-preview handling, apply scope wording, row-state reason text, staged-path provenance, and result undo evidence without changing backend rename behavior.
reason: Rename apply mutates files on disk, so the existing three-section workbench needs clearer operator guardrails while preserving the current minimal flow.
behavior_before: Rename preview/apply copy did not always make stale preview scope, all-safe default apply scope, row blocker reasons, staged path provenance, or result undo evidence explicit at the point of action.
behavior_after: Rename keeps the current workbench but disables stale preview apply, uses explicit apply-scope labels, strengthens filesystem confirmation copy, surfaces blocker reasons in status cells, summarizes staged-path origins, and repeats undo manifest evidence in result feedback.
tests_added: Updated tests/python/desktop/test_rename_workbench.py for Rename labels, confirmation copy, stale/apply-scope JS strings, and no visible Queue controls.

Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_rename_smoke.py for browser-backed origin counts, stale preview state, checked/all-safe apply copy, blocked-row status reason, and result dialog undo evidence.
Updated tests/webview/test_webview_rename_readiness_smoke.py for stale preview disabling, dynamic apply copy, blocker status text, origin counts, and undo evidence.
manual_validation: git diff --check for touched Rename files - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the Rename WebView partial, Rename JS updates, focused Rename test updates, generated summaries for touched files, and this change packet.
